{{Top|leg}}
'''''Sulyet''''' was a type of [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] cuisine. It consisted of small slices of sea creatures attached to [[tikit grain]] and served fresh at a bar right next to the chef. Not only was it served raw, it was preferably served while it was still moving. Pieces that were still moving were seen as a sign of freshness. It had a sweet and sour taste. The types of seafood used included purple [[coral worm]], nudibranch, and [[nexufish]]. [[Sourwort|Purple sourwort]] was a popular garnish. [[Jax Pavan]] had sulyet during his visit to [[Gort's]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] restaurant.

{{Food-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Sulyet appears to based on real world [[Wikipedia:Sushi|sushi]], as it was similar in both serving style and composition. Tikit grain may have been the equivalent of sushi rice, and nexufish possessed characteristics similar to [[Wikipedia:Fugu|fugu]].
